articles.title: DEEPO: Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization for Hallucination in MLLMs
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28570v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to sharpen reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its effect on hallucination is uneven. We trace this to two weak points in the \emph{correction chain} from reward to parameter update. At the rollout level, hard queries---those with high semantic entropy---frequently produce unanimously wrong sample groups, collapsing the group-relative advantage to zero exactly where hallucination risk is highest. At the optimization level, confident-but-wrong tokens are gradient-invisible: a catego
articles.summary: DEEPO proposes dual-entropy enhanced policy optimization to address hallucination in multimodal LLMs, targeting weak points where high-entropy queries collapse group-relative advantage and confident-but-wrong tokens become gradient-invisible.
articles.summaryZhHK: DEEPO 提出雙熵增強策略優化方法，處理多模態 LLM 嘅幻覺問題，針對高熵查詢令群組相對優勢歸零、以及自信但錯誤嘅 token 喺梯度中隱形呢兩個弱點。

articles.title: TWIST: A Proposed Benchmark for Intervention Quality in Conversational Memory, with a Human-Validated Draft-Alignment
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-conversation memory benchmarks increasingly test recall and prompted knowledge updates, and recent work studies evolving user beliefs and memory state. TWIST is a proposed benchmark suite for a complementary, unmeasured property: intervention quality -- whether a deployed memory system, exercised through its own ingest/recall/vet surface, acts correctly at belief change points. Four tracks cover unprompted tension detection, vetting outgoing drafts against the record, answering with current beliefs while preserving supersession history, and
articles.summary: TWIST is a proposed benchmark suite measuring intervention quality in conversational memory systems at belief change points, with four tracks covering tension detection, draft vetting, answering with current beliefs, and preserving supersession history.
articles.summaryZhHK: TWIST 係一套建議中嘅基準測試，用嚟量度對話記憶系統喺信念改變點嘅干預質素，分四條賽道：張力偵測、草稿審核、用當前信念作答，同埋保留被取代嘅歷史。

articles.title: Adversarial Closed-Loop Curriculum for Evolving Role-Playing Agents
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Role-playing agents based on large language models have been widely applied in areas such as personalized assistance and social simulation. Recent RL methods typically train on a fixed scenario pool collected before learning begins. This creates a distributional bottleneck: as the agent improves, the scenarios where it performs poorly also change, while the training distribution remains static. articles.summary: AdvRole proposes an adversarial context rewriting framework that turns role-playing RL into a closed-loop curriculum, alternating between generating harder scenarios and training the agent to address the distributional bottleneck of static scenario pools.
articles.summaryZhHK: AdvRole 提出一個對抗式情境改寫框架，將角色扮演 RL 變成閉環課程，交替生成更難嘅情境同訓練 agent，解決靜態情境池造成嘅分佈瓶頸。

articles.title: Training Object Permanence in World Models
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Object permanence and solidity are hallmarks of human cognitive priors. Recent studies show that video generation models, a paradigmatic class of current world models, have begun to show emerged reasoning abilities, making them ideal candidates for building human-like physical intelligence. Do video models have emerged object permanence in them? If not, could we train them with a core-cognition inspired dataset? We introduce WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence), a data infrastructure of 150 hand-designed cognitive science inspired tasks,
articles.summary: Researchers introduce WROP (World Reasoning with Object Permanence), a data infrastructure of 150 hand-designed cognitive science inspired tasks, to test and train object permanence and solidity in video-generation world models.

articles.title: Beyond Surface Style: Aligning Multi-Turn User Simulators with Behavioral Consistency
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28690v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Faithful user simulation is fundamental to building, evaluating, and improving interactive AI at scale. However, plausible individual responses do not ensure that simulated users reproduce the intent evolution and outcomes observed in real interactions. We propose TRACER, a multi-turn user simulator that explicitly models users' evolving intent and learns to align simulated behavior with real interaction trajectories. TRACER is trained in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on real user dialogues, followed by multi-turn reinforcement learning. The
articles.summary: Researchers propose TRACER, a multi-turn user simulator that models users' evolving intent and aligns simulated behaviour with real interaction trajectories via supervised fine-tuning followed by multi-turn reinforcement learning.

articles.title: Driving Epidemic Models with AI Agents: the Epydemix Agent Framework
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial Intelligence agents based on large language models provide convenient natural language interfaces to scientific software, but reliability is not automatic. Here we introduce the Epydemix Agent Framework, an additive layer over Epydemix, an open-source Python library for stochastic compartmental epidemic modeling. The framework extends the library with four capabilities to facilitate interaction with an AI agent: discovery of available models and parameters, preventive validation of a declarative scenario specification, execution throug
articles.summary: The Epydemix Agent Framework adds an LLM-agent layer over the open-source Epydemix Python library for stochastic compartmental epidemic modelling, offering model discovery, preventive validation of declarative scenario specs, and execution.

articles.title: Progressive Skill Discovery as Access Control for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Structural Governance through Role-Scoped Capability Delivery
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents struggle to scale safely when exposed to vast enterprise toolsets. Providing an agent with access to every internal tool leads to oversized context windows, degraded tool selection, and severe governance vulnerabilities - as system policies defined purely in prompts remain probabilistic advice rather than hard constraints. articles.summary: Researchers introduce skilder, a framework that packages capabilities with role-scoped access control for tool-using LLM agents, aiming to turn policy compliance into hard structural constraints instead of probabilistic prompt advice.

articles.title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Small Search Agents
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) performs well on problems with clear rewards, such as mathematics and coding, but whether it also works where the reward is less clear remains open. articles.summary: A study tests Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) for open-domain question answering on a sub-1B-parameter model, training Qwen3.5 without distillation from a larger teacher.

articles.title: Agent Memory with Episodic Retrieval for Financial Decision-Making
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in financial analysis and reasoning, inspiring recent advances in agent-based trading frameworks. While these systems show promise, prior approaches either emphasize long-horizon forecasting or operate as stateless analyzers, limiting their applicability to the demands of trading in complicated settings. articles.summary: Researchers present META (Memory Enhanced Trading Agent), a RAG-like episodic-memory-augmented multi-agent framework for financial decision-making that moves beyond long-horizon forecasting and stateless analyzers.

articles.title: RECLAIM: Can Agents Reproduce the Claims of Machine Learning Papers?
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.28850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reproducing a machine learning paper involves most research steps, from installing software and debugging to running experiments, work that AI agents increasingly do. We introduce RECLAIM, a benchmark of 100 NeurIPS 2025 papers that can be rebuilt yearly from new conferences. articles.summary: Researchers introduce RECLAIM, a benchmark of 100 NeurIPS 2025 papers where an agent must reproduce a pre-fixed result within a set GPU-hour budget, with fixed reproduction criteria and difficulty tiers based on what authors released.

articles.title: AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology
articles.snippet: AI is hitting a fixed benchmark performance level at a rapidly falling cost. Epoch AI measures a price decline of about 13x per year. Reasoning models, for example, can cost more because they use far more compute per task. When picking a model for real-world use, quality, speed, and error rate matter just as much as price. articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this report, we introduce \textbf{Ovis-Embedding}, a state-of-the-art omni-modal embedding family built on native integration of text, image, video, and audio. Instead of assembling separate modality towers, Ovis-Embedding uses a shared multimodal backbone to encode different modalities in a common representation space. Specifically, we make \textbf{three key advances}: (1) \textbf{native omni-modal initialization}: we adopt a pretrained Qwen-omni model as the embedding backbone and adapt it through contrastive training with low-rank initializ
articles.summary: Ovis-Embedding introduces an omni-modal embedding family using a shared multimodal backbone built on a pretrained Qwen-omni model with contrastive training low-rank initialization, unifying text, image, video, and audio in one representation space.
articles.summaryZhHK: Ovis-Embedding 推出一個 omni-modal embedding 系列，用共享多模態 backbone，基於預訓練 Qwen-omni 模型配合對比式訓練嘅低秩初始化，將文字、圖像、影片同音頻統一喺同一個表示空間。

articles.title: X-Planner: Event-Structured Task Planning for Embodied Intelligence
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Task planning bridges high-level instructions and executable behavior in long-horizon manipulation, yet modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems often leave this intermediate structure implicit. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) planners also tend to rely on coarse task-level annotations or serialize long reasoning traces token by token. We present X-Planner, a planning front-end that addresses both the supervision and representation of embodied reasoning. Our planning data combine Ego, UMI, and teleoperation under a hierarchy granularity with s
articles.summary: X-Planner presents an event-structured planning front-end for embodied intelligence, combining Ego, UMI, and teleoperation data under hierarchical granularity to address supervision and representation limits of chain-of-thought planners in long-horizon manipulation.
articles.summaryZhHK: X-Planner 提出一個以事件結構為本嘅規劃前端，用喺具身智能，將 Ego、UMI 同遙操作數據按層級粒度整合，解決現有 chain-of-thought 規劃器喺長時序操作任務上嘅監督同表示限制。

articles.title: Lean Pool: An AI-Maintained Archive of Formalized Mathematics
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lean Pool is a repository of formalized mathematics. It is grown, maintained and optimized by AI agents.
articles.summary: Lean Pool is a repository of formalized mathematics that is grown, maintained, and optimized by AI agents.
articles.summaryZhHK: Lean Pool 係一個形式化數學嘅資料庫，由 AI agent 負責擴充、維護同埋優化。

articles.title: The AI Neuroscientist: An Interactive Agentic Interface for Neuroimaging Analysis
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25254v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Analyzing neuroimaging data requires specialized coding and statistical expertise, which limits accessibility for researchers without computational backgrounds. We present the AI Neuroscientist, a language agent for interactive data exploration. The system integrates a large language model (LLM) with a neuroimaging toolset to perform quality control, modeling, and visualization. This allows researchers to query data quality and specify analysis parameters directly in natural language, providing a transparent and interactive alternative to convent
articles.summary: The AI Neuroscientist is a language agent that pairs an LLM with a neuroimaging toolset so researchers can run quality control, modeling, and visualization via natural-language queries.
articles.summaryZhHK: AI Neuroscientist 係一個語言 agent，將 LLM 同神經影像工具集結合，令研究員可以用自然語言查詢嚟做品質控制、建模同可視化。

articles.title: MedGate-Fusion: Integrating First-Encounter Semantic Narratives and Physiological Biomarkers for Prospective Stroke Risk Stratification
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prospective stroke risk stratification in primary care is challenging because early risk signals are distributed across routine biomarkers and unstructured clinical narratives. We propose MedGate-Fusion, a multi-modal gated architecture that integrates transformer-based embeddings of first-encounter narratives with ten routinely recorded risk markers. We used electronic medical record data from the Canadian Primary Care Sentinel Surveillance Network (CPCSSN). Starting from 808,921 encounter-level observations, we constructed a first-encounter coh
articles.summary: MedGate-Fusion is a multi-modal gated architecture combining transformer embeddings of first-encounter clinical narratives with ten routine risk markers from CPCSSN electronic medical records for prospective stroke risk stratification.
articles.summaryZhHK: MedGate-Fusion 係一個多模態閘控架構，將首次就診臨床敘述嘅 transformer embedding 同 CPCSSN 電子病歷中十個例行風險指標結合，用嚟做前瞻性中風風險分層。

articles.title: When LLM Agents Fail to Read the Room: ReAdapt for Relational Social Reasoning
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A social agent's most basic decisions (should I react to this post? who should I reach out to?) are not purely content problems. The right action often hinges on the latent relationship between people -- tie strength, reciprocity, mutual connections -- rather than on which content is most salient. Standard LLM agent loops do not explicitly represent how new relational evidence should revise the agent's current social hypothesis, leaving them prone to surface-obvious choices when relational and content cues diverge. We formalize this failure mode
articles.summary: ReAdapt addresses how LLM agents fail at relational social reasoning because standard agent loops do not explicitly represent how new relational evidence should revise the agent's social hypothesis.
articles.summaryZhHK: ReAdapt 針對 LLM agent 喺人際社交推理上嘅失誤，因為標準 agent loop 冇明確表示新嘅關係證據應該點樣修正 agent 嘅社交假設。

articles.title: Attention as a Routing Graph: Live Circuit Extraction from a Single Forward Pass
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finding circuits in language models usually means running many careful interventions. We try something simpler: treat attention as a routing map from one forward pass, keep a small set of routes that point toward the answer, and ask whether those routes actually matter. They often do. On induction and IOI (tasks where the "right" circuit is already known), ablating our extracted edges hurts the model much more than ablating a random set of the same size. We evaluate n=100 prompts per cell on GPT-2 Small, GPT-2 Medium, and Pythia-410M, with paired
articles.summary: The paper treats attention as a routing graph extracted from a single forward pass, showing that ablating the extracted edges hurts models like GPT-2 Small, GPT-2 Medium, and Pythia-410M far more than ablating random edges of the same size.
articles.summaryZhHK: 呢篇論文將 attention 當做由單次 forward pass 抽出嚟嘅路由圖，發現喺 GPT-2 Small、GPT-2 Medium 同 Pythia-410M 上，切除抽出嘅邊比切除同等數量隨機邊對模型傷害大好多。

articles.title: Learned Enterprise Data Comprehension: Compression and Routing for Data Agents
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured-data agents in enterprise settings must reason over complex data environments whose relevant evidence is distributed across schemas, relationships, policies, and recurring business roles. Modern agentic systems often address this burden through reusable markdown-style memory or skill files that preserve previously discovered information for later queries, reducing the need to rediscover the same structure repeatedly. This is useful, but it obscures a natural division of labor: agents are well suited to semantic reasoning, while learned
articles.summary: A new arXiv paper proposes learned compression and routing so enterprise data agents can reason over complex schemas, relationships and policies, dividing labour between semantic reasoning and learned retrieval instead of relying on reusable markdown-style memory files.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇新嘅 arXiv 論文提出用學習式壓縮同路由，令企業數據 agent 可以喺複雜嘅 schema、關聯同政策上面做推理，將語義推理同學習式檢索分工，唔再單靠可重用嘅 markdown 式記憶檔案。

articles.title: Making Agents More Consistent: Skills Should Form Habits for Repeat Tasks
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On repeated work, agents are inconsistent. We ran 42 tasks three times each and found that, depending on the model, 38% to 74% returned answers that did not agree. Consistency is what a buyer, an auditor, or a regulator requires, and agents do not have it. They are wasteful too: 95.3% to 97.2% of what an agent generates goes to re-deriving a plan the system already knows. We propose skill habit formation. An agent mines its own execution history for candidate skills, deterministic variants that compete against the incumbent rather than replacing
articles.summary: A new arXiv paper reports that across 42 tasks run three times each, 38% to 74% of agent answers disagreed depending on the model, with 95.3% to 97.2% of generated tokens spent re-deriving already-known plans, and proposes 'skill habit formation' where agents mine their own execution history for deterministic skill variants.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇新 arXiv 論文發現，42 個任務各跑三次，視乎模型有 38% 至 74% 嘅答案唔一致，而 95.3% 至 97.2% 嘅生成內容係用嚟重新推導系統已知嘅計劃；論文提出「技能習慣化」，等 agent 從自己嘅執行歷史挖出確定性嘅技能變體。

articles.title: Potential for Enhanced Learning in Machine Learning Classes by Using Wiki LLM Indexing
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as course-specific tutors, but their usefulness depends on grounding in vetted instructional materials that are often revised mid-semester. Our prior work built a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over an authentic machine learning course corpus (Foundations of Machine Learning) and found that retrieval improved contextual grounding, but that fixed retrieval strategies were suboptimal. That motivates a different question: whether how a corpus is structured at ingest time matters
articles.summary: An arXiv paper studies whether structuring a machine learning course corpus with Wiki LLM indexing at ingest time improves how LLMs act as course-specific tutors grounded in vetted instructional materials.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文研究喺機器學習課程語料入庫時用 Wiki LLM indexing 整理，會唔會令 LLM 做課程專屬導師時更貼實已審核嘅教材。

articles.title: Clarification Is Not Correction: LLMs Fail to Let Go
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dialogue failures in language models are usually framed as memory failures: context too long, summaries lossy, a constraint forgotten. We argue this misses a deeper problem: in many conversations the model does not forget, it commits too early. An ambiguous early turn collapses into a single hidden interpretation, and later clarification is filtered through that commitment. articles.summary: An arXiv paper argues that dialogue failures are often not memory failures but 'early posterior collapse', where an ambiguous early turn collapses into a single committed interpretation that later clarification cannot correct; evaluated with controlled dialogue tasks.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文話對話出錯通常唔係記憶問題，而係「早期後驗崩塌」——開頭一句模稜兩可嘅話collapse成單一隱含解讀，之後點澄清都改唔返；研究用受控對話任務去驗證。

articles.title: From Decorative to Load-Bearing: Task Difficulty Shapes the Causal Role of Chain-of-Thought
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is only meaningful if written reasoning causally constrains the answer. We introduce continuation-based causal testing, an ablation-patch intervention that perturbs one reasoning step, truncates the chain, and forces the model to continue from the corrupted prefix. It measures how load-bearing a CoT is for the final answer, a behavioral notion distinct from mechanistic faithfulness. Across Gemma-2-9B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on GSM8K, MMLU, and BIG-Bench Hard, CoT load-bearingnes
articles.summary: An arXiv paper introduces continuation-based causal testing, an ablation-patch intervention that measures how 'load-bearing' a chain-of-thought is for the final answer, tested on Gemma-2-9B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B across GSM8K, MMLU and BIG-Bench Hard.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文提出基於續寫嘅因果測試，用 ablation-patch 干預去量度 chain-of-thought 對最終答案有幾「受力」，喺 Gemma-2-9B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 同 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 上面用 GSM8K、MMLU 同 BIG-Bench Hard 測試。

articles.title: Robust Failure, Conservative Repair: Textual Knowledge Distillation from Cross-Model Failures
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.25400v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Failure-based textual knowledge distillation aims to discover gaps in a model's knowledge by examining its task errors. The distilled knowledge can be useful for the reasoning of both this model ("source model") and other models. However, this transfer of knowledge may not be stable. We define a rule atom to be a standalone rule injected into a model's textual input at inference time. A rule atom can encode transferable task knowledge or model-specific reasoning patches that can confuse other models. Also, the injected rule atoms can be misapplie
articles.summary: An arXiv paper studies failure-based textual knowledge distillation via 'rule atoms' injected at inference time, finding that transfer of distilled knowledge is unstable and that model-specific patches can confuse other models.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文研究基於失敗案例嘅文字知識蒸餾，用推論時注入嘅「rule atom」，發現知識轉移唔穩定，而且針對特定模型嘅修補規則會搞亂其他模型。

articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.20971v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-context large language model inference is increasingly limited by prefill, where dense self-attention processes the entire prompt before generation begins. Sparse block selection can reduce this cost, but a block centroid may hide a highly relevant token among many irrelevant ones. We call this failure mode mean dilution and propose RBS-Attention, a training-free sparse-prefill method with two complementary selection branches. A centroid base branch captures average relevance, while a rescue branch uses the maximum key-block radius and its p
articles.summary: Researchers propose RBS-Attention, a training-free sparse-prefill method for long-context LLM inference that uses a centroid base branch plus a rescue branch using maximum key-block radius to overcome the mean dilution failure mode.

articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.20974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Mixture-of-Experts language models, the router typically selects and weights experts based on the token's hidden state, utilizing limited contextual information. We propose Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments the router with temporal and spectral features extracted from a sliding window of attention weights that represent a summary of the model's contextual state, disentangled from the hidden state. Keeping the base transformer entirely frozen, we train only the routing parameters, isolating routing as the sole variable. AAR improves
articles.summary: Researchers propose Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments the router in Mixture-of-Experts language models with temporal and spectral features from a sliding window of attention weights, training only routing parameters while keeping the base transformer frozen.

articles.title: CaLR: Causal Latent Revision for Robust Diffusion Reasoning
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.20981v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models suffer from local greediness, while diffusion language models (DLMs) often lack the strict causal structure required for reasoning. To combine the advantages and overcome the drawbacks of the dual, we propose Causal Latent Revision (CaLR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as constrained latent optimization. By adopting a causal topology matrix (CTM) from an expert model and implicit differentiation, CaLR performs gradient-guided ``thought revision" to enforce logical consistency, enabling dynamic self-correction
articles.summary: Researchers propose Causal Latent Revision (CaLR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as constrained latent optimization, using a causal topology matrix from an expert model and implicit differentiation for gradient-guided "thought revision" and dynamic self-correction.
articles.summaryZhHK: 研究人員提出 Causal Latent Revision（CaLR），將推理重新定義為受約束嘅潛在優化，用嚟自專家模型嘅 causal topology matrix 同隱式微分，做梯度引導嘅「思路修正」同動態自我糾正。

articles.title: LoRA Enhanced Contrastive Learning with SAS Vision Transformers
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automatic target recognition (ATR) with synthetic aperture sonar (SAS) supports advanced naval capabilities, but deep learning is constrained by scarce target imagery, background clutter, and human-in-the-loop assessment. We adapt DINOv3 Vision Transformer (ViT) models to underwater SAS ATR using a three-stage parameter-efficient framework. Stage 1 uses Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) while freezing the ViT backbone, bridging the gap between natural-image pretraining and underwater acoustic propagation. Stage 2 uses hard-negative mining to strengthen
articles.summary: A three-stage parameter-efficient framework adapts DINOv3 Vision Transformers to synthetic aperture sonar automatic target recognition using LoRA and hard-negative mining.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一個三階段嘅參數高效框架，用 LoRA 同 hard-negative mining 將 DINOv3 Vision Transformer 適應到合成孔徑聲納嘅自動目標識別任務。

articles.title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we examine the topology of information flow patterns within attention graphs to effectively distinguish hallucinated from non-hallucinated responses. We analyze the Forman-Ricci curvature to identify structural patterns indicating information bottlenecks in attention graphs. We then introduce a method that captures both semi-local and global information-flow characteristics of attention heads associated with hallucinated responses. We evaluate our approach extensively across several LLMs and established benchmarks. Empirical results
articles.summary: Researchers use Forman-Ricci curvature to analyze attention graph topology and detect LLM hallucinations by tracing structural information bottlenecks in attention heads.
articles.summaryZhHK: 研究人員利用 Forman-Ricci 曲率分析注意力圖嘅拓撲結構，透過追蹤注意力頭之中嘅結構性資訊瓶頸嚟偵測 LLM 幻覺。

articles.title: Decoupling Internal Representational Changes and Causal Importance in Fine-Tuned Large Language Models
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21113v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fine-tuning has emerged as a widely adopted approach for adapting LLMs to a variety of downstream tasks. However, how it reshapes their internal mechanisms remains poorly understood. To address this, we investigate how fine-tuning alters internal representations in LLMs, including attention patterns and layer-wise activations, and examine whether these changes are linked to task-relevant components identified by EAP (e.g., attention heads and logit-level activations) that drive task performance. We find that EAP-identified components are concentr
articles.summary: A study investigates how fine-tuning reshapes internal LLM representations, including attention patterns and layer-wise activations, and whether these changes link to task-relevant EAP-identified components.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一項研究探討微調點樣重塑 LLM 內部表徵，包括注意力模式同逐層激活，以及呢啲變化係咪同 EAP 識別到嘅任務相關組件有關。

articles.title: TinyCeNN-LM: Quality-Gated Conversion of Pretrained Attention with CeNN-Inspired Cellular-Recurrent Layers
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Replacing attention in a pretrained language model is a compatibility problem: a plausible substitute may alter representations expected by later layers. TinyCeNN-LM introduces a \emph{quality-gated post-training conversion} framework using CeNN-inspired cellular-recurrent layers with bounded local processing, compact recurrent memory, routing, fusion, and accept-or-rollback validation. Three implementations are studied: Integrated Memory, MemoryFusion, and PDelta3-GDN2-CLVR+Local32. Strict PDelta3 conversion accepts a layer only when representat
articles.summary: TinyCeNN-LM introduces a quality-gated post-training framework that converts pretrained attention into CeNN-inspired cellular-recurrent layers with accept-or-rollback validation.
articles.summaryZhHK: TinyCeNN-LM 提出一個 quality-gated 嘅後訓練框架，將預訓練注意力轉換成受 CeNN 啟發嘅細胞遞歸層，配以 accept-or-rollback 驗證機制。

articles.title: Can Agents Design Better Chips with a Higher Level Abstraction?
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for chip design, but most existing approaches operate directly at RTL. We ask whether agents can design better chips by leveraging higher-level abstractions. We compare Direct RTL Design, Agent-based HLS Design, Post-Compiler HLS Refinement, and Post-HLS RTL Refinement, and combine Agent-based HLS Design with Post-HLS RTL Refinement as Agent-based HLS with RTL Refinement (AHRR). We use FPGAs as a practical, easy-to-deploy platform for end-to-end evaluation, but note that the design
articles.summary: A study asks whether LLM agents can design better chips using higher-level abstractions, comparing Direct RTL Design, Agent-based HLS Design, and combined HLS-RTL refinement on FPGAs.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一項研究探討 LLM agent 可唔可以利用更高層次嘅抽象去設計更好嘅晶片，比較 Direct RTL Design、Agent-based HLS Design 同結合 HLS-RTL 精修嘅方案，並喺 FPGA 上做評估。

articles.title: SpecOpt: Contact-Diff Reasoning for Agentic Molecule Optimization Toward Binding Specificity
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Off-target protein binding is a major source of adverse effects for small-molecule drugs, yet most structure-based molecular design methods focus on generating selective compounds de novo rather than improving the selectivity of existing, well- characterized drugs. We introduce specificity optimization (SpecOpt), a molecular design task that seeks constrained structural modifications to an existing compound that increase its binding preference for an intended target over known off-targets while preserving its structural identity and drug-like pro
articles.summary: SpecOpt introduces a molecular design task that makes constrained structural modifications to an existing drug to boost binding preference for its intended target over known off-targets while preserving drug-like properties.
articles.summaryZhHK: SpecOpt 提出一個分子設計任務，對現有藥物做受約束嘅結構修改，令佢對目標蛋白嘅結合偏好高過已知 off-target，同時保留藥物樣特性同結構身份。

articles.title: Implicit Rule Induction with Test-Time Task Embeddings in ARC-like Tasks
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21181v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus and related benchmarks evaluate whether AI models can solve novel reasoning tasks, but often leave unclear whether success reflects inference of the intended underlying rule or reliance on shortcuts. We address this gap by studying test-time task embeddings in Vision ARC (VARC), a model in which a pre-trained backbone is complemented by a trainable embedding representing the transformation rule. In the original VARC, test-time training (TTT) is jointly applied to the backbone and task embedding. Here we introd
articles.summary: The paper studies test-time task embeddings in Vision ARC (VARC) to test whether models solving ARC-like tasks actually infer the intended underlying rule or rely on shortcuts, extending VARC's joint test-time training of backbone and task embedding.
articles.summaryZhHK: 篇論文研究 Vision ARC（VARC）入面嘅 test-time task embeddings，睇下模型解 ARC 類任務時係真係推斷到背後嘅規則，定係靠捷徑；同時延伸 VARC 原本對 backbone 同 task embedding 一齊做 test-time training 嘅做法。

articles.title: AI-GRACE: A Use-Case Operationalization Framework for Agentic AI: From Organizational Objectives and Obligations to Deployment Capabilities and Architecture
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organizations deploying agentic artificial intelligence must determine more than whether a model is trustworthy; they must establish what to validate, control, and observe for a use case to deliver its intended outcome while meeting applicable obligations. This paper proposes AI-GRACE (Agentic Intelligence-Governance, Risk, Assurance, Controls, and Evidence) as a use-case operationalization framework connecting organizational governance with technical implementation. The proposal draws on professional observations and a purposive synthesis of sta
articles.summary: AI-GRACE is a use-case operationalization framework that links organizational governance, risk, assurance, controls and evidence with the technical implementation of agentic AI deployments.
articles.summaryZhHK: AI-GRACE 係一套 use-case 落地框架，將組織嘅治理、風險、保證、控制同證據，同 agentic AI 部署嘅技術實作扣埋一齊。

articles.title: Information-Gain Rewards over Diversity-Pruned Tests: GT-Anchored Verifier Co-Training for Reliable Code Generation
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21208v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-play methods that co-train a single language model as both coder and test author promise to move code-generation RL beyond fixed test suites, but they suffer from two coupled pathologies: permissiveness collapse, where pass-rate rewards are maximised by trivial, non-discriminative tests, and concentration bias, where i.i.d. sampled tests cluster on modal inputs and inflate estimator variance. We introduce CoVer (Co-trained Coder and Verifier), a single-policy GRPO framework that addresses both failure modes. First, an information-gain (IG) r
articles.summary: CoVer is a single-policy GRPO framework that co-trains one language model as coder and verifier using information-gain rewards over diversity-pruned tests, targeting permissiveness collapse and concentration bias in self-play code generation RL.
articles.summaryZhHK: CoVer 係一個單一 policy 嘅 GRPO 框架，用 information-gain 獎勵配合多樣性修剪過嘅測試，同時訓練同一個語言模型做 coder 同 verifier，針對 self-play 程式生成 RL 入面嘅 permissiveness collapse 同 concentration bias 兩大問題。

articles.title: PlaceReasoner-Beta: Reasoning-Driven Macro Placement and Benchmarking
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated macro placement remains a fundamental challenge in VLSI physical design. Despite decades of research, existing approaches predominantly optimize hand-crafted proxy objectives, such as estimated wirelength, and typically produce placements through one-shot numerical optimization, limiting their ability to incorporate visual layout context, codified design expertise, and downstream physical-design feedback in a unified loop. We present PlaceReasoner-Beta, a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates macro placement as a close
articles.summary: PlaceReasoner-Beta is a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates VLSI macro placement as a closed loop, letting the model incorporate visual layout context, codified design expertise and downstream physical-design feedback instead of one-shot proxy optimization.
articles.summaryZhHK: PlaceReasoner-Beta 係一個 verifier 引導嘅多智能體框架，將 VLSI macro placement 重新定義成一個閉環流程，令模型可以納入視覺佈局脈絡、編碼化嘅設計經驗同下游物理設計回饋，唔再係一shot過嘅 proxy 數值優化。

articles.title: Efficient Benchmarking in Production: A Study of an Evolving LLM Agent
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Production LLM agents are evaluated repeatedly as they evolve, but full agent benchmarks are costly to rerun. We study efficient recurring evaluation for a production analytics agent serving tens of thousands of monthly active users and report first-hand deployment experience. Using 574 historical runs of the production benchmark, split chronologically into calibration and held-out periods, we compare random sampling, historical caching, fixed representative subsets, and IRT-based adaptive testing. The results show that multidimensional 2PL adapt
articles.summary: Using 574 historical runs of a production analytics agent benchmark serving tens of thousands of monthly users, the study compares random sampling, historical caching, fixed subsets and IRT-based adaptive testing, finding multidimensional 2PL adaptive testing most efficient for recurring evaluation.
articles.summaryZhHK: 研究用一個服務每月數萬用戶嘅生產級 analytics agent benchmark 嘅 574 次歷史 run，比較隨機抽樣、歷史快取、固定子集同 IRT 自適應測試，發現多維 2PL 自適應測試喺反覆評估上最有效率。

articles.title: GameASG-Bench: Benchmarking Autonomous Software Generation for Game Development
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.21293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous software generation (ASG) aims to turn human requirements into executable applications, but delivering these applications does not necessarily establish that their interacting components satisfy the specified behavioral requirements. We introduce GameASG-Bench, a benchmark that makes behavioral testability part of the generation task for game development. Our design declares an evaluation interface specification before generation, fixing legal starting scenarios, player-level actions, stable snapshots, rejection behavior, and invariant
articles.summary: GameASG-Bench makes behavioral testability part of autonomous software generation for games, declaring an evaluation interface specification before generation that fixes legal starting scenarios, player-level actions, stable snapshots, rejection behavior and invariants.
articles.summaryZhHK: GameASG-Bench 將行為可測試性納入遊戲嘅自主軟件生成任務，喺生成之前先訂明評估介面規格，固定合法起始場景、玩家層面動作、穩定快照、拒絕行為同不變量。

articles.title: Does AI need an antitrust exemption so it doesn’t kill everyone????

These days, he’s both a professor of law at WashU and professor of technology policy at Carnegie Mellon. The biggest story in tech right now is the spiraling debate about AI safety and regulation. Researchers at the big AI labs including Anthropic and Google DeepMind have quit in noisy ways, saying the models pose real threats and safety isn’t being taken seriously across the industry

articles.title: The AI regulation smackdown isn’t over

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Google DeepMind co-founder Demis Hassabis, and even SpaceX CEO Elon Musk publicly seemed to agree on aspects of all three things. Anthropic and OpenAI had already been dropping hints that t

articles.title: BioPhys-Bridge: A Benchmark for Interdisciplinary Scientific Reasoning in Physics-Grounded Biological Research
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models face unique challenges in analyzing interdisciplinary scientific research literature. In biophysics research, faithful answers require grounding observed data in source evidence, interpreting it through a quantitative physics model, and linking it to a biological mechanism. To address this challenge, we introduce BioPhys-Bridge, a novel benchmark dataset for evidence-grounded scientific reasoning over biophysical literature. Each case contains evidence blocks, stable evidence IDs, quantitative values, units, equations, assumptions
articles.summary: Researchers introduce BioPhys-Bridge, a benchmark dataset for evidence-grounded scientific reasoning over biophysical literature, where each case contains evidence blocks, stable evidence IDs, quantitative values, units, equations, and assumptions.
articles.summaryZhHK: 研究人員推出 BioPhys-Bridge，一個針對生物物理文獻、以證據為本嘅科學推理基準數據集，每個案例都包含證據區塊、穩定嘅證據 ID、量化數值、單位、方程式同假設。

articles.title: What Do We Expect from LLMs? Mapping the Design of LLM Benchmarks
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19182v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmarks are central to how progress in large language models (LLMs) is assessed and communicated. Yet model rankings alone reveal little about how evaluation requirements themselves are changing. The expanding variety of benchmarks offers another perspective: what researchers expect LLMs to do, and what they count as successful performance. We systematically map 14,767 papers introducing or updating evaluation resources from arXiv submissions between January 2022 and August 2026. Using staged screening and automated full-text coding, we examin
articles.summary: Researchers systematically mapped 14,767 arXiv papers introducing or updating evaluation resources between January 2022 and August 2026 to examine what researchers expect LLMs to do and what counts as successful performance.
articles.summaryZhHK: 研究人員系統咁梳理咗 2022 年 1 月至 2026 年 8 月期間、14,767 篇介紹或更新評估資源嘅 arXiv 論文，探討研究人員期望 LLM 做到啲乜，同埋佢哋覺得點先算成功。

articles.title: Position: It is Time to Virtualize Foundation Models with a Self-evolving Operating System Layer
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI applications have shifted from single, monolithic foundation models (FM) to compound agentic systems. Yet today's stacks remain fragmented: even as protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) ease tool/agent connectivity, each framework embeds an implicit runtime for state, memory, budgets, and guardrails, making behavior non-portable and governance brittle. It mirrors computing before operating systems, when every program re-implemented basic services. This position paper argues that the field now needs a Foundation Model Operating System (FMOS) -- a system l
articles.summary: An arXiv position paper argues for virtualizing foundation models behind a self-evolving Foundation Model Operating System (FMOS) layer to make state, memory, budgets and guardrails portable across fragmented agentic stacks.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 立場論文主張將基礎模型虛擬化，加一層可自我演化嘅 Foundation Model Operating System（FMOS），令狀態、記憶、預算同護欄可以喺零散嘅 agentic 系統之間互通。

articles.title: What Do Current Systematic Generalization Tasks Miss? A Reasoning-Centered Analysis
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19212v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Systematic generalization, the ability to solve novel problems by recombining known atomic elements, is central to human intelligence but difficult to study rigorously under controlled settings. Existing studies therefore rely on simplifications such as approximately linear action composition, productivity-based tests, and action-explicit goals, which make systematic generalization easier to study but omit some essential aspects of this capability. To characterize what these simplifications miss, we adopt a reasoning-centered lens and introduce T
articles.summary: An arXiv paper uses a reasoning-centered lens to analyze what current systematic generalization tasks miss, arguing existing simplifications such as approximately linear action composition and productivity-based tests omit essential aspects of the capability.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文以推理為中心嘅角度，分析現有系統性泛化任務漏咗啲乜，指現有嘅簡化做法——例如近似線性動作組合同基於生產力嘅測試——忽略咗呢種能力嘅核心部分。

articles.title: Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19244v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conversational LLM agents increasingly rely on Web search, yet the end-to-end lifecycle of agentic search remains poorly understood. We present the first study of Web search across four major conversational platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek), combining real-world user interactions (invivo) with controlled experiments using the same platform's models by their APIs (invitro). We investigate the quality of agentic decisions to invoke Web search, their strategies to formulate queries, the potential domain preferences in the search result
articles.summary: The first study of Web search across four major conversational platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and DeepSeek) combines real-world user interactions with controlled API experiments to examine agentic search decisions, query strategies, result domain preferences and responses.
articles.summaryZhHK: 首個橫跨四大對話平台（ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 同 DeepSeek）嘅網頁搜尋研究，結合真實用戶互動同用 API 做嘅受控實驗，檢視 agentic 搜尋嘅決策、下 query 嘅策略、搜尋結果嘅網域偏好同最終回應。

articles.title: Do AI Agents Understand Computer Architecture?
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agents are increasingly asked to design hardware, and increasingly reported to succeed. Such reports establish that a design improved; they cannot establish why. An agent that improves an accelerator may be reasoning about the machine, or may be searching competently over knobs whose meaning it never recovers -- and only the first transfers to the next architecture. Existing evaluations cannot tell the two apart, because they vary the agent while holding the framing of the problem fixed. We do the opposite. AutoTuring hands the same agent the sam
articles.summary: An arXiv paper introduces AutoTuring to test whether AI agents genuinely reason about computer architecture or merely search competently over knobs whose meaning they never recover.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文提出 AutoTuring，用嚟測試 AI agent 究竟係真係理解電腦架構，抑或只係喺佢哋根本唔知意思嘅旋鈕上面亂咁搜。

articles.title: MAGS: Multi-agent Auto-formalization Guarantees Safety for Agentic Outputs
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19391v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM coding agents now generate complex programs at a scale that makes thorough human review increasingly difficult, raising the risk of safety and security failures. Common approaches, including fuzz testing, static analysis, and LLM-as-a-Verifier, can detect many failures but struggle to cover all possible edge cases. Formal verification addresses this by providing machine-checkable guarantees over specified properties, but traditionally demands substantial manual specification and proof engineering. We introduce a unified multi-agent framework,
articles.summary: MAGS is a multi-agent auto-formalization framework that aims to give machine-checkable safety guarantees for code generated by LLM coding agents, which traditional fuzzing and static analysis struggle to fully cover.
articles.summaryZhHK: MAGS 係一個 multi-agent auto-formalization 框架，目標係為 LLM coding agent 生成嘅程式碼提供機器可檢查嘅安全保證，填補傳統 fuzzing 同靜態分析覆蓋唔到嘅位。

articles.title: Closed-World Resolution Against Tool Hallucination in LLM Agents
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-augmented large language model (LLM) agents fail in a way no tool-selection or tool-security method addresses: they call tools that do not exist and pass arguments no schema declares. Existing defenses either pick the right tool (selection) or constrain what an agent may do with real tools (gating), both of which presuppose the emitted call refers to a real tool at all. We show this is a structural blind spot: a hallucinated call is by construction not a decision any gate made, so no gate can reject it. This paper is primarily a measurement
articles.summary: An arXiv paper identifies tool hallucination in LLM agents as a structural blind spot — since a hallucinated call was never a real decision, no gating or tool-selection defence can reject it — and proposes a closed-world resolution approach.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文指出，LLM agent 嘅 tool hallucination 係一個結構性盲點——因為幻覺出嚟嘅 call 本身唔係真決定,任何 gating 或 tool-selection 防禦都擋唔到——並提出 closed-world resolution 嘅方法。

articles.title: Compositional Reasoning in Language Models under Reinforcement Learning Post-Training
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compositional reasoning is critical for real-world problem solving: since training data is necessarily limited, models must generalize by composing learned skills in new ways. While post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the reasoning abilities of language models (LMs), their effects on compositional reasoning remain less well understood. We propose a dependency-graph framework to formalize compositional reasoning, yielding three levels of compositionality with increasing complexity. Empirically, we
articles.summary: An arXiv paper proposes a dependency-graph framework formalizing three levels of compositional reasoning and studies how RL post-training affects language models' ability to generalize by composing learned skills.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文提出 dependency-graph 框架，將 compositional reasoning 形式化為三個層次，並研究 RL post-training 點影響語言模型透過組合所學技能嚟泛化嘅能力。

articles.title: Safety Beyond the Interface: Detecting Harm via Latent States in Large Language Models
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts.
articles.summary: Researchers extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight 12.6M-parameter MLP probes to detect harmful prompts via latent states, aiming to remove the latency and compute overhead of external guardrail models.
articles.summaryZhHK: 研究人員抽取 LLaMA-3.1-8B 嘅 activations，訓練只得 12.6M 參數嘅輕量 MLP probe，透過 latent states 偵測有害 prompt，目標係唔使再靠外部 guardrail 模型嘅延遲同算力開銷。

articles.title: QVAC Genesis III: A Large-Scale, High-Quality Open Synthetic STEM Corpus for Efficient Language Model Pre-Training
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-quality pre-training data is a critical bottleneck for educational and STEM-specific language models targeting edge AI and on-device deployment where token budgets are tightly constrained. While major organizations train ever-larger models on private corpora, the open ecosystem lacks STEM-focused synthetic datasets that deliver high per-token learning value efficiently for small models. To address this gap, we introduce QVAC Genesis III, a 191.43B-token, STEM-focused multi-domain synthetic corpus covering 19 domains across several difficulty
articles.summary: QVAC Genesis III is a 191.43B-token, STEM-focused multi-domain open synthetic corpus covering 19 domains, designed to give small edge-deployed language models high per-token learning value under tight token budgets.
articles.summaryZhHK: QVAC Genesis III 係一個 191.43B token、專攻 STEM 嘅多領域開放合成語料庫，涵蓋 19 個領域，目標係喺 token 預算緊絀嘅情況下，為部署喺邊緣裝置嘅細模型提供高 per-token 學習價值。

articles.title: LLM-as-an-Improver: Turning Verification into Better Candidates
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19515v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Verifier-based selection improves LLM performance by generating multiple candidate solutions and using a verifier to select the most promising one. However, existing methods typically treat verification only as a ranking step and discard its feedback once a fixed candidate pool has been evaluated. In this paper, we ask whether verification can also improve the candidate set itself. To this end, we introduce LLM-as-an-Improver and propose Verify--Repair--Reselect (VRR), which uses verification feedback to generate and reselect improved candidates.
articles.summary: The paper introduces LLM-as-an-Improver and proposes Verify–Repair–Reselect (VRR), which uses verification feedback to generate and reselect improved candidates rather than treating verification only as a ranking step.
articles.summaryZhHK: 篇論文提出 LLM-as-an-Improver，並提出 Verify–Repair–Reselect（VRR），用驗證反饋去產生同重揀更好嘅候選答案，而唔係淨係將驗證當做一個排名步驟。

articles.title: An Architecture for Long-Horizon Agents: Levels, Ticks and Cascaded Intelligence
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19519v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to carry out work spanning days or weeks, such as an operations remediation or a research programme. Such a task outlives any context window, any process and any interval at which a person can attend. In this paper, we argue that a long-horizon agent must run continually without forgetting before it can learn continually. This ability lies in the harness around the model rather than in the model itself. We derive seven bottlenecks from the long-horizon setting and answer them with a hierarchical archit
articles.summary: The paper argues long-horizon language-model agents must run continually without forgetting before they can learn continually, deriving seven bottlenecks and answering them with a hierarchical architecture of levels, ticks, and cascaded intelligence.
articles.summaryZhHK: 篇論文主張長遠期嘅語言模型 agent 必須可以持續運行而唔會忘記，先至可以持續學習，並歸納出七個瓶頸，用層級、ticks 同串聯智能嘅階層式架構去回應。

articles.title: EconSkills: Studying Skill Transfer and Retrieval for Web Agents on Live Economic Data
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Web agents often revisit the same sites, yet most evaluations discard the procedures learned in earlier successful interactions. We introduce EconSkills, a skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures for retrieving live economic data. Each skill records its scope, navigation procedure, site-specific guidance, verification checks, and recovery steps while replacing source-instance values with placeholders. EconSkills separates two questions: whether a know
articles.summary: EconSkills introduces a skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures for retrieving live economic data, separating whether a skill can be transferred from whether it can be retrieved.
articles.summaryZhHK: EconSkills 提出一個技能庫同評估框架，將已驗證嘅 EconWebArena 軌跡蒸餾成參數化嘅標準作業程序，用嚟檢索實時經濟數據，並分開處理技能可否轉移同可否檢索兩個問題。

articles.title: A Unified Evaluation Framework for Trustworthy Large Language Models, Agentic AI, and Multimodal Systems
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.19524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmark scores alone provide an incomplete basis for assessing the trustworthiness of modern artificial intelligence systems. Large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, and multimodal models (MLLMs) require different forms of assessment, yet their evaluation evidence must remain interpretable for development and oversight. We propose a unified framework that connects output-level, trajectory-level, and cross-modal assessment through eight trustworthiness dimensions: capability, robustness, safety, fairness, transparency, governance, oversig
articles.summary: The paper proposes a unified evaluation framework connecting output-level, trajectory-level, and cross-modal assessment through eight trustworthiness dimensions — capability, robustness, safety, fairness, transparency, governance, oversight, and others — for LLMs, agentic AI, and multimodal systems.
articles.summaryZhHK: 篇論文提出一個統一評估框架，透過八個可信度維度——能力、穩健性、安全、公平、透明、治理、監督等等——將輸出層、軌跡層同跨模態評估連埋一齊，適用於 LLM、agentic AI 同多模態系統。

The rule to never use a turn of phrase suggested by an LLM feels good to me. The

Now 25 recipients of the Fields medal – often called the Nobel prize for maths – have signed an open letter expressing their fears of a ‘severe misalignment’ between AI companies and their field. On long videos (>20 min), full-coverage CaptionQA with
articles.summary: CapMem is a human-annotated benchmark for caption-based episodic memory in egocentric video, covering 75 videos totaling 33.7 hours and 1,000 multiple-choice questions across 16 scenarios.
articles.summaryZhHK: CapMem 係一個人工標註嘅基準，用嚟測試以第一人稱影片為基礎、靠字幕做情節記憶嘅能力，包含 75 條片共 33.7 小時，同橫跨 16 個場景嘅 1,000 條選擇題。

articles.title: GraphEcho: Structural Redundancy and Evidence Provenance in LLM Graph Agents
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A large language model (LLM) agent can follow more graph paths without acquiring more independent evidence. GraphEcho tests whether agents mistake these repeated encounters for additional corroboration. The benchmark varies path counts and evidential origins while holding evidence content fixed, and evaluates both judgments and active exploration. Controlled synthetic experiments reveal model-dependent judgment shifts, but redundant supporting paths increase the share of repeated walks across all evaluated frozen agents. Provenance-aware post-tra
articles.summary: GraphEcho tests whether LLM graph agents mistake repeated path encounters for additional corroboration, varying path counts and evidential origins while holding evidence content fixed; redundant supporting paths increased repeated walks across all evaluated frozen agents.
articles.summaryZhHK: GraphEcho 測試 LLM 圖代理會唔會將重複行過嘅路徑誤當成額外佐證；佢喺固定證據內容之下改變路徑數量同證據來源，結果顯示冗餘嘅支持路徑喺所有受測凍結代理身上都增加咗重複走訪嘅比例。

articles.title: NeMo Data Designer: An Extensible Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Generation
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present NeMo Data Designer (NDD), an open-source, general-purpose framework for multi-modal synthetic data generation (SDG). Designed to be intuitive to use, NDD provides a declarative configuration format in which human and/or agent users define each dataset column, with column types spanning text, code, structured outputs, images, embeddings, and statistical samplers that are explicitly configured to steer dataset diversity. Additional column types and functionality can be introduced using the framework's flexible plugin system. NDD's config
articles.summary: NVIDIA's NeMo Data Designer (NDD) is an open-source, general-purpose framework for multimodal synthetic data generation, using a declarative config format and a plugin system to define dataset columns spanning text, code, structured outputs, images, and embeddings.
articles.summaryZhHK: NVIDIA 嘅 NeMo Data Designer（NDD）係一個開源、通用嘅多模態合成數據生成框架，用 declarative config 格式同 plugin 系統去定義 dataset 欄位，涵蓋文字、程式碼、結構化輸出、圖像同 embeddings。

articles.title: Imitation Learning for Autonomous Driving in CARLA
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17757v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Behavioral cloning trains a policy offline on expert demonstrations, but deployment is closed loop: each action affects the observations the policy receives next. We study how much closed-loop driving competence a compact multimodal policy can acquire from offline demonstrations in the CARLA simulator. The policy uses five-frame histories of RGB images, LiDAR, vehicle telemetry, and lane waypoints to predict throttle, brake, and steering at 20 Hz. Demonstrations were collected in three stages, ending with a systematic route-generation procedure t
articles.summary: A study of imitation learning for autonomous driving in the CARLA simulator, where a compact multimodal policy trained by behavioural cloning on offline demonstrations predicts throttle, brake, and steering at 20 Hz from RGB, LiDAR, telemetry, and lane waypoints.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇研究喺 CARLA 模擬器入面做自動駕駛 imitation learning 嘅論文：一個細小嘅多模態 policy 用 behavioural cloning 喺離線示範上訓練，靠 RGB、LiDAR、vehicle telemetry 同 lane waypoints 以 20 Hz 預測油門、煞車同轉向。

articles.title: SAGE: Governed Artifact Generation from Enterprise Guidelines
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise guideline documents mix narrative text, complex tables, and embedded images, and converting them into structured work artifacts still takes two to three days of manual effort each. Current language and vision-language models extract from such documents but offer no governed workflow beyond extraction: no validation, no consistency checking, no traceable artifact generation. We introduce SAGE, a governed multi-stage LLM pipeline organized around a shared versioned rule store with stable identifiers, schema-validated inter-stage contract
articles.summary: SAGE is a governed multi-stage LLM pipeline that converts enterprise guideline documents — mixing narrative text, complex tables, and embedded images — into structured work artifacts, adding validation, consistency checking, and traceable generation via a shared versioned rule store.
articles.summaryZhHK: SAGE 係一條受治理嘅多階段 LLM pipeline，將企業指引文件（混合敘述文字、複雜表格同內嵌圖像）轉成結構化工作產出，並透過共享嘅 versioned rule store 加入驗證、一致性檢查同可追溯嘅生成流程。

articles.title: FairCompressAgent: An Agentic Framework for Fairness-Aware Model Compression for FPGA Deployment
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fairness-aware model compression requires selecting methods and configurations that balance accuracy, fairness, and deployment cost. These decisions become more difficult when compression methods are composed or the user's requirements change. In this paper, we propose FairCompressAgent (FCA), an agentic framework that integrates fairness-aware pruning, incremental quantization, and sparse low-rank factorization through a common operator interface. A language-model planner uses model profiles and measured outcomes to select compression configurat
articles.summary: FairCompressAgent (FCA) is an agentic framework that combines fairness-aware pruning, incremental quantization, and sparse low-rank factorization for FPGA deployment, with an LLM planner selecting compression configurations from model profiles and measured outcomes.
articles.summaryZhHK: FairCompressAgent（FCA）係一個 agentic 框架，結合 fairness-aware pruning、incremental quantization 同 sparse low-rank factorization 嚟部署喺 FPGA，並由 LLM planner 根據 model profiles 同實測結果揀壓縮配置。

articles.title: A Four-Stage Decomposition of Word-Problem Solving and Mechanistic Fragility in LLM Math Reasoning
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17804v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models solve grade-school math word problems with high accuracy, yet a single irrelevant clause inserted into the problem can collapse it. We reconcile these observations with a mechanistic account. We show that the model's internal computation decomposes into a four-stage sequential pipeline, Schema Abstraction, Operation Planning, Operand Binding, and Computation, each stage producing a distinct intermediate representation in an identifiable band of layers. Using the same scaffold to diagnose distractor-induced failure, we locali
articles.summary: The paper decomposes LLM math word-problem solving into a four-stage pipeline — Schema Abstraction, Operation Planning, Operand Binding, and Computation — and uses it to locate where a single irrelevant clause causes mechanistic failure.
articles.summaryZhHK: 呢篇論文將 LLM 解數學應用題嘅過程拆成四階段 pipeline：Schema Abstraction、Operation Planning、Operand Binding 同 Computation，並用呢個框架定位單一句無關子句點樣引發 mechanistic failure。

articles.title: SNOMED CT Concept Recommendation from Masked Clinical Context
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standardizing clinical language to SNOMED CT supports interoperability, analytics, and reusable phenotyping, but concept recommendation remains difficult when relevant concepts are rare or absent from training data. We present a masked-concept recommendation benchmark using the SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge v1.2.1 data derived from MIMIC-IV-Note. The dataset contains 75,491 annotations across 272 discharge summaries, with 204 notes used for training and 68 for historical testing. For each unique note-concept pair, the target mention is maske
articles.summary: The paper presents a masked-concept recommendation benchmark for SNOMED CT built on the SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge v1.2.1 data from MIMIC-IV-Note, covering 75,491 annotations across 272 discharge summaries with 204 notes for training and 68 for testing.
articles.summaryZhHK: 呢篇論文提出一個 SNOMED CT masked-concept recommendation benchmark，建基於 MIMIC-IV-Note 嘅 SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge v1.2.1 資料，包含 272 份出院摘要共 75,491 個標註，其中 204 份用嚟訓練、68 份用嚟測試。

articles.title: The Inference Engineering Pareto Atlas: Which Optimizations Dominate the Cost, Quality, and Latency Frontier?
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM inference optimizations report speedups on different models, GPUs, prompts, and quality metrics, making them hard to compare or combine. We build a cost, quality, and latency Pareto atlas to identify the best configurations for different deployment constraints. Since exhaustive testing is impractical, we measure 54 configurations of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct running on vLLM 0.12 across L4, A100, and H100 GPUs and use these anchors to calibrate a simulator. It reproduces measurements at anchored batch sizes, with cross campaign drift below 1.5 perce
articles.summary: The Inference Engineering Pareto Atlas measures 54 configurations of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on vLLM 0.12 across L4, A100, and H100 GPUs to map the cost, quality, and latency frontier and calibrate a simulator with cross-campaign drift below 1.5 percent.
articles.summaryZhHK: Inference Engineering Pareto Atlas 喺 L4、A100 同 H100 GPU 上量度 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 喺 vLLM 0.12 嘅 54 種配置，繪製成本、質素同延遲嘅前緣，並校準出跨 campaign drift 低於 1.5 percent 嘅模擬器。

articles.title: Do Frontier Models Seek Safety Evidence Before Acting?
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier models are often evaluated on how they respond to safety information once it is already in context. We study an earlier decision point: whether models choose to acquire safety-relevant evidence before acting. We introduce SAFE, a controlled benchmark in which models make deployment decisions with optional evidence that varies in retrieval cost, probability, severity, and presentation. articles.summary: The SAFE benchmark studies whether frontier models seek safety-relevant evidence before acting, finding distinct evidence-acquisition policies across GPT-5.5, o3, Claude Opus 4.8, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 — with Opus inspecting nearly by default and o3 the most selective.
articles.summaryZhHK: SAFE benchmark 研究前沿模型會唔會喺行動之前主動攞安全相關證據，結果發現 GPT-5.5、o3、Claude Opus 4.8 同 Claude Sonnet 4.6 各有唔同嘅證據搜集策略——Opus 幾乎默認就會查，o3 就最揀擇。

articles.title: ERPBench: A State-Grounded Evaluation Paradigm for Computer-Use Agents in Enterprise Software
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computer-use agents that operate through screenshots and simulated actions are advancing rapidly, yet their evaluation remains anchored to general desktop and web tasks. Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems run the finance, procurement, inventory, and customer operations of organizations worldwide, and pose distinct challenges for computer-use agents: dense interfaces, coordinated multi-step interactions, and errors that alter persistent business records rather than surfacing on screen. Existing enterprise benchmarks rely on proprietary pla
articles.summary: ERPBench is a state-grounded evaluation paradigm for computer-use agents in ERP systems, targeting dense interfaces, coordinated multi-step interactions, and errors that alter persistent business records rather than showing on screen.
articles.summaryZhHK: ERPBench 係一套以狀態為本嘅評估範式，專門評估喺 ERP 系統入面操作嘅 computer-use agents，針對密集介面、多步協調互動，以及唔會喺螢幕顯示但會改動持久業務記錄嘅錯誤。

articles.title: OBC-Prune: Outcome-Based Calibration for Large Reasoning Model Pruning
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate long chain-of-thought traces before answering, creating significant inference overhead. Pruning can reduce this cost, but its effectiveness depends on the calibration data used to estimate parameter importance. Recent work calibrates on the model's own rollouts instead of generic dataset, but treats all reasoning tokens uniformly, regardless of whether they contribute to successful reasoning. As a result, pruning protects weights by statistical salience rather than by their contribution to correct reasoning,
articles.summary: OBC-Prune introduces outcome-based calibration for pruning large reasoning models, weighting parameters by their contribution to correct reasoning rather than by uniform statistical salience across all chain-of-thought tokens.
articles.summaryZhHK: OBC-Prune 提出以 outcome-based calibration 嚟剪枝大型推理模型，按參數對正確推理嘅貢獻嚟定權重，而唔係將所有 chain-of-thought token 一視同仁咁計統計顯著性。

articles.title: Collaborative Memory for Multi-Agent VLM Systems
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17921v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) agents combine specialized perception, tools, and reasoning to address complex visual tasks. In multi-agent settings, different agents inspect different image regions, video frames, or visual representations, so collaboration extends beyond distributed reasoning to distributed perception. This makes shared visual context a central problem in VLM agent collaboration. In this paper, we frame memory hierarchy, cross-agent sharing, and consistency mechanisms around the need to reconcile interpretations and update dependent
articles.summary: An arXiv paper (2609.17921v1) proposes collaborative memory for multi-agent VLM systems, framing memory hierarchy, cross-agent sharing and consistency mechanisms around the need to reconcile distributed visual perception.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文（2609.17921v1）提出為多 agent VLM 系統設計協作記憶，圍繞記憶層級、跨 agent 共享同一致性機制，去解決分散式視覺感知需要互相協調嘅問題。

articles.title: When to Call an LLM: A Confidence-Gated Hybrid for Cost-Effective Emotion Recognition in Conversational AI
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.17977v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Emotion recognition in conversation (ERC) is a production capability behind agent-assist prompts, escalation routing, and post-call analytics in contact-center-as-a-service (CCaaS) platforms, where cost and latency constraints matter as much as accuracy. articles.summary: An arXiv paper (2609.17977v1) compares three deployment options for dialogue-contextual emotion recognition in CCaaS platforms — a stacked ensemble, off-the-shelf LLM prompting with GPT-4o-mini, and a confidence-gated hybrid — weighing cost and latency against accuracy.
articles.summaryZhHK: 一篇 arXiv 論文（2609.17977v1）比較 CCaaS 平台對話情境情緒辨識嘅三種部署方案——堆疊集成模型、用 GPT-4o-mini 嘅現成 LLM prompting，以及信心閘控混合方案——同時衡量成本同延遲對準確度嘅影響。

articles.title: The AI data center e-waste problem is huge — and getting bigger
articles.snippet: E-waste from the AI boom has been vastly underestimated, a new report warns. By 2050, it could become enough trash to fill 23 million shipping containers - roughly enough 40-foot containers to circle the world six times if lined up in a row. It's a significantly higher estimate of AI's e-waste than previous studies have found because the authors of the new report factor in all the infrastructure needed to support servers in data centers. The broader scope provides a clearer picture of junk AI leaves behind, according to the nonprofit Basel Action Network (BAN), which published the paper today.
articles.summary: A Basel Action Network report warns that AI data center e-waste has been vastly underestimated and could by 2050 fill 23 million shipping containers, roughly enough 40-foot containers to circle the world six times.
articles.summaryZhHK: Basel Action Network 一份報告警告，AI 數據中心嘅電子垃圾一直被嚴重低估，到 2050 年可能塞滿 2,300 萬個貨櫃，即係大約夠 40 呎貨櫃排起上嚟繞地球六個圈。
